author: Seung Wook
problem: A robot starts at (0, 0) facing the positive x direction, with positive y pointing up (north). Read N and a string T of 'S' and 'R': 'S' moves it one step forward and 'R' turns it 90 degrees clockwise (east to south to west to north). Print its final x and y.
bug_description: rotate() uses the current position self.y instead of the direction self.dy when computing the new dx, so turns after the robot has moved in y go the wrong way.

comments.accurate: Tracks the robot's position and heading, turning the heading 90 degrees clockwise on each R
comments.wrong_behavior: Tracks the robot; each R turns it clockwise and re-aims it based on how far it has drifted along y
comments.wrong_location: Rotation verified; check that move adds the heading to the position in the right order
